goals.label: The library is vendored at vendor/lib and committed on main
Three patches in ../outbox apply cleanly to the colleague's main
An annotated tag v2.0 on main that verifies with the release key

checks.script: fp=$(ssh-keygen -lf "$LESSON_ROOT/keys/release-key.pub" | cut -d' ' -f2); git verify-tag v2.0 2>&1 | grep -qF "$fp"

goals.label: ../release-2.0.tar.gz holds the tagged tree under release-2.0/, library included, tests excluded

check.script: f="$LESSON_ROOT/release-2.0.tar.gz"; [ -f "$f" ] && l=$(tar tzf "$f") && echo "$l" | grep -q '^release-2.0/src/lantern.py$' && echo "$l" | grep -q '^release-2.0/vendor/lib/version.txt$' && ! echo "$l" | grep -q '/tests/.'

goals.label: ../app.bundle verifies and carries main and v2.0

check.script: f="$LESSON_ROOT/app.bundle"; git bundle verify "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git bundle list-heads "$f" | grep -q 'refs/heads/main$' && git bundle list-heads "$f" | grep -q 'refs/tags/v2.0$'
